build.beforeBuildCommand: cargo build --manifest-path ../../Cargo.toml --release -p continuum-mcp --bin continuum-mcp && ../../packaging/prepare-gstreamer-plugins.sh && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Local-first continuity workspace for research and development.
bundle.longDescription: Continuum preserves research evidence, development history, provenance, checkpoints, reports, and bounded AI handovers in one local-first desktop application.
